rows.label: tlk70000034_05_msg0001
rows.name: Did you see it?! Sarah's shy smile?!

rows.label: tlk70000034_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I've never heard a 'thank you' worth
that much before!

rows.label: tlk70000034_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Ah, Sarah! Every time I think of you,
my heart trembles like a newborn fawn
and plays endless songs of love!!

rows.label: tlk70000034_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Love truly is wonderful... The world
looks completely different than before
I met her!!
